channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Houthi forces launch missiles and drones at Yemen’s port city of Mocha
item.description: Houthi forces renew missile and drone strikes on the Red Sea port city of Mocha, targeting Saudi-backed military assets amid mounting tensions.

item.title: Former NY Governor David Paterson on fighting Mamdani’s antisemitism
item.description: "I think that there is in some respects confusion in the black community. There are some people who hear things that Mamdani says and it reminds them of some things that happened to them at some point." Interview.

item.title: Drama in New Jersey: F-16s scrambled near Trump’s golf club
item.description: Drama in New Jersey: F-16s scrambled near Trump’s golf club

item.title: Montreal: Government blow to Hasidic institutions
item.description: Three educational institutions affiliated with the Belz Hasidic movement in Montreal lost their licenses just before the start of the school year due to ongoing systemic failures.

item.title: Two aircraft entered restricted airspace over Trump's golf club over the weekend
item.description:
US media reported that two civilian aircraft entered restricted airspace over Bedminster, New Jersey, where President Donald Trump’s golf club is located and where he was staying at the time.
F-16 fighter jets were scrambled toward the aircraft and escorted them out of the restricted airspace.

item.title: Trump: US 'low keying' Iran
item.description: Trump says US will maintain economic pressure on Iran for now, as Tehran delays a Strait of Hormuz agreement and demands an end to the war.

item.title: Central Command chief signs intent notice to destroy home of terrorist who murdered Yehuda Sherman
item.description: The head of IDF Central Command signed a notice of intent to confiscate and demolish the home of terrorist Duas Hasson, who carried out the attack in the Beit Imrin area in which Yehuda Sherman was killed and another civilian was wounded.

item.title: Watch: Son of former MK arrested with loaded pistol near Ramla
item.description: Police arrested the son of a former MK after finding a loaded FN pistol in his vehicle during a traffic stop on Route 44 near Ramla.

item.title: Trump shares Hillary Clinton column backing his Gaza peace plan
item.description: Trump shares Clinton's defense of his Gaza plan as a former World Bank official challenges her view and warns Palestinian skepticism remains deep.

item.title: Rambam Medical Center defended amid criticism: 'They were fighting alongside us'
item.description: Didi Krieger, whose brother was critically wounded during the war, described his family's experience at the Rambam Medical Center: 'They did everything they could to save lives.'

item.title: Government expands housing discounts for reservists nationwide
item.description: Netanyahu, Katz and Smotrich unveil housing plan offering 20,000 reservists apartments and land, with discounts topping NIS 500,000.

item.title: Syria: ISIS cell captured near Golan Heights
item.description: Syrian security forces in Damascus arrested nine terrorists in the city of Khan Arnabeh, near the Golan Heights. The arrests come amid efforts to thwart the smuggling of drones and missiles to Hezbollah.

item.title: Arab parties unite for joint election run
item.description: Hadash, Balad, and Ta'al join forces to run in the elections with the stated goal of 'toppling the fascist right-wing government.'

item.title: Elad deputy mayor: 'They threatened to stop treating my father'
item.description: Elad Deputy Mayor Yaniv Badalov files complaint against Ichilov staff, alleging elderly patient was left bleeding and his father's treatment was conditioned on his leaving the department.

item.title: Haredim must become full partners in Am Yisrael’s national mission
item.description: For too long, the established Haredi parties have treated the right-wing public as a coalition partner but not as a partner in a shared national mission. That must change.

item.title: Minister Chikli against UNESCO: Palestinian heritage? A joke!
item.description: Minister of Diaspora Affairs and Combating Antisemitism Amichai Chikli blasts UNESCO over recognition of Sebastia as Palestinian heritage site.

item.title: Haredim must become full partners in Am Yisrael’s national mission

item.title: Bereaved father says minister's daughter evacuated from Nova before Hamas massacre
item.description: Nissim Louk, father of Shani Louk, murdered at the Nova festival, recounts his confrontation with Minister Miri Regev and calls for fundamental change and building bridges among the people.

item.title: Child who went missing in Jordan River found dead
item.description: Teen found dead after rescue forces conduct extensive searches in Jordan River he fell from a boat and contact with him was lost.

item.title: Efforts to rescue teen who fell while rappelling
item.description: 16-year-old boy falls while rappelling in the Keshet Cave in northern Israel. Rescue forces currently have no access to him. Helicopter dispatched.

item.title: Viral moment: Groom breaks glass with bride's prosthetic leg
item.description: Social media influencer Esty Segal lost her leg to cancer as a teenager. After standing at her side through a difficult rehabilitation process, her groom used her prosthetic leg to break the glass.

item.title: Underground | Hezbollah weapons tunnel destroyed in southern Lebanon
item.description: The IDF uncovered and neutralized an underground facility used to store weapons belonging to the Lebanese terrorist organization Hezbollah. During the operation, anti-tank missiles, RPG rockets, and artillery weapons were located.

item.title: Weapons cache uncovered in Binyamin region
item.description: A short while ago, a team from the Judea and Samaria District’s interagency headquarters operated in the Binyamin area and located a cache of weapons. Police bomb disposal experts were called to the scene, while a suspect who was present at the site attacked the officers and injured them. The suspect was arrested.

item.title: The new police desk leading charge against anti-Israel activists
item.description: A Judea and Samaria-based special police desk has helped deport 47 foreign activists and block 130 others from entering Israel amid a crackdown on BDS activity.

item.title: Watch: Infiltrator found hiding in secret compartment in trunk
item.description: Border Police discovered a Palestinian Arab from Judea and Samaria hiding inside a concealed trunk compartment at a checkpoint east of Jerusalem.

item.title: Marla Maples says Trump carries Zohar over his heart for protection
item.description: Donald Trump’s ex-wife says the president carries an Aramaic copy of the Zohar close to his heart, while sharing details of his spiritual side and her own connection to Judaism, Israel and Shabbat.

item.title: $5 million distributed to haredi institutions that reject government funding
item.description: במעמד שנערך במעונו של הרב משה שטרנבוך בירושלים חולקו מענקים בסך כולל של כ-5 מיליון דולר למנהלי מוסדות חרדיים הנמנעים מקבלת תקציבים ותמיכות מרשויות המדינה. החלוקה היא חלק מסיוע שנתי של כ-17 מיליון דולר.

item.title: Report: Trump eyeing way out of Iran war without nuclear agreement
item.description: WSJ reports Trump could declare victory without a nuclear deal if Iran fully reopens the Strait of Hormuz and its nuclear threat remains contained.

item.title: Passengers panic as bus driver smashes window during route to Modi'in Illit
item.description: Driver allegedly lost his temper during confrontation with passenger after skipping a stop; Kavim suspended him pending investigation.

item.title: Sephora to open first stores in Israel this month
item.description: French beauty retailer Sephora will open its first stores in Israel on August 20. The initial locations will be at Azrieli Tel Aviv, Malha Mall, and Ayalon Mall, with three additional stores expected to open later.
